description_en: Associate a vSwitch with a cloud connector instance
description_zh: 将交换机与云连接器实例进行关联
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc associate-vswitch-with-iot-cloud-connector --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --vpc-id vpc-bp1aevy8sofi8mh1q0000 --vswitch-list vsw-m5e3r57pxkgijcdvfcdvf0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --dry-run false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateVSwitchWithIoTCloudConnector

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud connector
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC to associate with the cloud connector instance.

If this parameter is specified, **VSwitchList** must also be specified. If this parameter is not specified, **VSwitchList** must not be specified either
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例需关联的VPC的ID。

如果填写此参数则必须填**VSwitchList**；如果不填，则**VSwitchList**也不填
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of vSwitches in the client's VPC. The zone of each vSwitch must match the zone of the cloud connector instance.

**N** is set to **2**, indicating that exactly two vSwitches are required
parameters.help_zh:
客户端VPC下的交换机列表，并且交换机的可用区必须和云连接器实例的可用区一致。

**N**取值为**2**，表示必须为2个交换机
parameters.name: vswitch_list

parameters.help_en:
A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

This value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. It can contain up to 64 ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run of the request. Valid values:
- **true**: Sends a dry run request without associating the vSwitches with the cloud connector instance. The system checks whether required parameters are provided, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
- **false** (default): Sends a normal request. After passing the checks, the vSwitches are associated with the cloud connector instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
- **true**：发送检查请求，不会将交换机与云连接器实例进行关联。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接将交换机与云连接器实例进行关联
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the cloud connector instance is located.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id
